title: ICPC-2 Danish translations and coding guidance (from KiAP)
description: Danish-language designation and coding-guidance supplement for ICPC-2, containing 686 symptom and diagnosis codes. Process codes and Danish-only grouping codes are excluded. The authoritative source is KiAP ICPC-2-DK 4.4, [ICPC_v4_4_20260629.accdb](https://web.kiap.dk/resources/files/icpc/systemhuse/ICPC_v4_4_20260629.accdb), table ICPCKON2-v4_4_20260501, fields ICPC-kode and ICPC-diagnose. Narrative properties criteria, inclusion, exclusion, consider and note preserve Kriterier, Inkl, Ekskl, Overvej and Bemærk from preferred (Udl=1) rows valid on the source release date. Additional-match guidance is reported separately by the generator, not promoted to ICPC concept properties. Whitespace is normalized; cross-references remain source text, not executable rules. Conflicting source labels are resolved as follows: P70: Demens; R83: Infektion i luftveje IKA; S12: Insektstik. Codes are checked against international ICPC-2e v7.0. Generated by scripts/icpc2_da_supplement.py. The version and date identify the KiAP source file's release date. [KiAP documentation and releases](https://www.kiap.dk/praksis/icpc-2).
